title: Compute nonconical diffraction efficiencies
action: Implement rigorous coupled-wave analysis (RCWA) and the homogeneous-layer indices (first-order, second-order, higher-order) for a rectangular-groove grating with n1=1, n3=3.5, λ0/Λ=5, θ1=30°, φ=0°, and the design parameters from the paper's Table 1 (nonconical). Compute zero-order backward diffraction efficiency DE0 for TE and TM polarizations using each index model (first-order, second-order, higher-order) and optionally RCWA, and report results in a CSV.
description: Produces the nonconical DE0 comparison values. The agent must implement the homogeneous-layer model and RCWA. Output must contain rows for each polarization and model type as in Table 1 of the paper.
output_schema: Columns: polarization (str), model_type (str), de0 (float, percent). Example: TE,first_order,1.1958

title: Compute conical diffraction and model-RCWA comparison
action: For the grating designed to be antireflecting at normal incidence (TE, F=0.222, d/λ0=0.4010) and under TE-polarized conical incidence at φ=45°, θ1=45°, compute using RCWA and the higher-order homogeneous-layer model (HLM) the TE-component DE0, TM-component DE0, total DE0, and relative phase (degrees) as functions of λ0/Λ for λ0/Λ = 4,5,6,7,8,9,10. Output a CSV with columns for both HLM and RCWA results.
description: Evaluates the homogeneous-layer model accuracy for conical diffraction. The agent must run both the model and RCWA for each λ0/Λ point and report the results. The output provides the data to check self-consistency (close agreement between HLM and RCWA for λ0/Λ > 3.5).
output_schema: Columns: lambda_over_period (float), de0_TE_HLM (float), de0_TM_HLM (float), de0_total_HLM (float), phase_HLM (float, degrees), de0_TE_RCWA (float), de0_TM_RCWA (float), de0_total_RCWA (float), phase_RCWA (float, degrees). Rows for λ0/Λ = 4,5,6,7,8,9,10.
